description: Permanently deletes a specific Sentry issue, identified by its ID, from an organization; this operation is irreversible and idempotent.

issue_id.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the Sentry issue to be permanently deleted.
issue_id.title: Issue Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization to which the issue belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

name: delete_organization_issue

DeleteOrganizationIssueResponse.description:
Response schema for `DeleteOrganizationIssue`.

DELETE endpoints return empty response bodies on success. Single issue deletion returns
HTTP 202 (Accepted) as the operation is processed asynchronously. Bulk deletion returns
HTTP 204 (No Content) upon successful completion. Both endpoints return empty response
bodies on success with no fields.
DeleteOrganizationIssueResponse.title: DeleteOrganizationIssueResponse
